application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: Clear measurements (e.g., pre and post work height/width reductions) are required to ensure the Local Planning Authority can assess the impact. Please resubmit with an appropriate specification. For example: 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m.
description:
We would like to prune 2 trees on our property at 26 Sheen Park, Richmond, TW91UW. Firstly , labelled #1 on the sketch is a large Ash tree in our rear garden, then secondly , labelled #2 is a Golden Rain Tree in the front of our property. Both trees are large and need cutting back as they have not been pruned for some years.

Update: For Tree 1 on the diagram ( Ash tree ) , there is a current height of 8m with a crown width of 5m. We propose to reduce the height by 2m and crown by 1m leaving a height of 6m and crown of 4m.

For Tree 2 in the diagram ( Golden Rain Tree ), there is a current height of 7m but also a crown of 7m ( so it spreads over our neighbours driveway and over the street ). We propose to reduce the height by only 1m, but reduce the crown by 3m so that it doesnt spread everywhere. This will leave a 6m height and 4m crown.
